record_scope_reconstruction: Only Odzisi–Mosabruni/Razdakhan belongs to the accepted phases. The wider 2019 announcement also named Sinaguri, but the accepted cessation-to-monthly-opening phase and the 2026 weekly-hours phase are specifically Odzisi.

source_checks.finding: EUMM states Odzisi and Sinaguri remained closed from 20:00 on 4 September 2019; no reopening date was then known.
EUMM October 2022 account identifies monthly Odzisi and Karzmani openings since August 2022, leaving regular access restricted.
16 October 2026 EUMM inspection says Odzisi is now open Thursday through Sunday and still advocates full reopening.
Explicit Odzisi-Mosabruni/Razdakhani equivalence supplies the identity bridge to the OSM border_control node.

date_scope_check.qualification: Odzisi is common to both endpoint accounts; Sinaguri and Karzmani are not silently equated. The whole August 2022 endpoint range is retained. Medical permissions and special-pass holiday openings, including June 13–17, 2022 and an earlier Easter window, are exceptions to the ordinary-passage restriction. This is not a continuously sealed all-person frontier. Later monthly 20th–30th windows remain limited access.
